messages:
Nora Li: Heads-up: we're doing a mug exchange + eco-wreath craft in the lounge at 5:30 today. Bring a mug (gently used is fine) or a wreath material. Low-key, BYO twinkle lights. :mug: :herb:
Jamal: Ooh love this. I'll bring extra glue guns and wire cutters. Also, can we have a tiny fake-snow machine? Kidding... maybe. :snowflake: :grin:
Ivy: Count me in. Question: do we want a label swap so mugs don't get stolen? Stickers + names?
Nora Li: Yes stickers! I'll print name tags and an "adopt-a-mug" table. Also planning a 2-minute shoutout round for people who helped this quarter.
Liam: Shoutout to Ops for the weekend deploy rescue 10/10 drama-free save. Also if anyone wants to add holiday songs to a collaborative playlist: https://playlists.redwood/seasonal
Zoe: Posting a meme for morale: https://imgur.com/fake-meme-holiday (you know the one). :joy:
Ivy: Quick poll: react with :one: for 'mug exchange only', :two: for 'wreaths too', :three: for 'bring snacks instead', :four: for 'silent carol karaoke later'. @here
Jamal: :two: (wreaths) and I'll bring string lights.
Liam: :four: (silent carol karaoke) 1 that sounds hilarious.
OpsBot: OpsBot: Reminder: Office closes at 2pm on Dec 24 and reopens Jan 2. For access exceptions, submit a ticket. :lock:
Nora Li: Also starting the kudos thread now  I'll go first: Zoe for the onboarding docs revamp, Jamal for the CI timeout fix, and Ivy for the design ops handbook.
Zoe: Thanks! Team's been crushing it. :sparkles:
Jamal: Appreciate it. See you all at 5:30  I'll bring very tiny candy canes.
Ivy: If someone wants to caravan to the holiday market after, DM me.
Nora Li: Locked in. Thanks everyone  photos encouraged but keep it PG. :camera_with_flash:
